compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined The Son of Man will come with his angels beside Abraham expects an angel to go before the servant; After the calf, God says his angel will go before; God promises an angel but withholds his own presence; A prophet falsely claims an angel spoke. Those passages share its angelic register or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
